summary: Treat namespace as emitted object/IIFE, not a C# static namespace abstraction.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

semantics.this: no invented shared CLR object/reference model

tests.name: object model
tests.input: namespace N { export const x=1 }; console.log(typeof N);

tests.name: augmentable
tests.input: namespace N { export const x=1 }; (N as any).y=2; console.log((N as any).y);
